boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Mississippi State destinations for gathering, creating, studying, recreation, and campus events.

cards.title: The Drill Field
cards.subtitle: Central campus greenspace
cards.notes: Use this central lawn as a meeting point or a place to pause between classes; check campus calendars for scheduled events before setting up.
cards.short_summary: A historic central greenspace used for campus gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Mississippi State identifies the historic Drill Field, at the center of campus, as a popular greenspace gathering area.
cards.source_title: The Drill Field | Mississippi State University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus greenspace; planned events may affect use.

cards.title: The Junction
cards.subtitle: Near Davis Wade Stadium
cards.notes: Walk the paved connection between the Junction and Drill Field, and consult athletics or campus-event information when game-day activity is planned.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU Alumni describes the Junction as a pedestrian-friendly central-campus focal point and gathering place linked by paved walkways to the Drill Field.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor area beside Davis Wade Stadium; event activity can change access.

cards.title: Colvard Student Union
cards.subtitle: 198 Lee Boulevard
cards.notes: Check Cowbell Connect for events, then use the Union’s common facilities as a central starting point for a meeting, exhibit, or meal break.
cards.short_summary: A multipurpose hub with event rooms, an auditorium, gallery, and dining.
cards.evidence_claim: The Colvard Student Union lists multipurpose and conference rooms, Fowlkes Auditorium, an art gallery, ballroom, and dining options.
cards.access_notes: Event rooms and services may require reservation; dining purchases are separate.

cards.title: Union Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Colvard Student Union, Suite 314
cards.notes: Look for the current exhibition before visiting, and use the displayed work as a low-key conversation or sketching prompt with friends.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery presenting work by students, alumni, and outside artists.
cards.evidence_claim: The Union Art Gallery says it presents exhibits featuring work by MSU students, alumni, and external artists to encourage creativity and connection.
cards.source_title: Union Art Gallery | Center for Student Activities
cards.access_notes: Located in the Colvard Student Union; exhibition availability may vary.

cards.title: Mitchell Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: 395 Hardy Road
cards.notes: Reserve a group room with your NetID when working with classmates, or use an unreserved room first-come, first-served while following library rules.
cards.short_summary: A library study destination with reservable collaborative rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU Libraries says Mitchell Memorial Library meeting and study rooms are for collaborative work and study, with reservations available to MSU affiliates.
cards.source_title: Room Reservation and Use Policies | Mississippi State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Room reservations require MSU affiliation, NetID, and NetPassword; unreserved use is first-come, first-served.

cards.title: MaxxSouth Digital Media Center
cards.subtitle: Mitchell Memorial Library
cards.notes: Choose a named studio or the Makerspace for a media project, then make any required reservation early through the library’s room system.
cards.short_summary: A library-based destination for media work, makerspace use, and studio projects.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU Libraries lists the MaxxSouth Digital Media Center’s AV, collaboration, photography, TV, virtual-reality, and Makerspace spaces.
cards.access_notes: Some studios require reservations or approval; check the individual room listing.

cards.title: Old Main Academic Center
cards.subtitle: Library-managed academic spaces
cards.notes: For a collaborative work session, reserve an Old Main group study room or use available space respectfully when no reservation is in effect.
cards.short_summary: An academic center with group study rooms and library-supported spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU Libraries lists group study rooms, an amphitheatre, auditorium, gallery, and other spaces at Old Main Academic Center.
cards.access_notes: Study-room use is intended for collaborative academic work; reservations take priority.

cards.title: Chapel of Memories
cards.subtitle: Historic campus chapel and bell tower
cards.notes: Pause outside to view the bell tower and brickwork, then respect any ceremony or private use taking place at the chapel and its garden.
cards.short_summary: A campus landmark built with brick recovered from Old Main.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU reports that the Chapel of Memories opened in 1967 and incorporates bricks that had been the exterior of Old Main residence hall.
cards.access_notes: Respect ceremonies and private events; interior availability is not stated on the source.

cards.title: Joe Frank Sanderson Center
cards.subtitle: 225 Bailey Howell Drive
cards.notes: Bring your student credentials and choose a recreation option that fits your schedule, from fitness areas to courts, track, pool, or climbing features.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU’s 2026–27 catalog says the Sanderson Center offers recreation facilities including courts, fitness equipment, jogging track, and an indoor pool.
cards.source_title: University Recreation | Mississippi State University Catalog
cards.access_notes: University recreation serves students, faculty, and staff; verify membership and facility access before arrival.

cards.title: Chadwick Lake
cards.subtitle: Next to the Sanderson Center
cards.notes: Take a stroll around the lake next to Sanderson; if fishing, first confirm that you have the required Mississippi and campus permits.
cards.short_summary: A campus lake beside the recreation center for a walk or permitted fishing.
cards.evidence_claim: Mississippi State’s guest-services page states Chadwick Lake is next to the Sanderson Center and is available for fishing with a license or for a stroll.
cards.source_title: University Recreation | Mississippi State University Guest and Conference Services
cards.access_notes: Fishing requires a fishing license; use the area responsibly and follow campus recreation guidance.
